what: Cross-vendor model-tier correspondence. A memory vault's agent definitions name a model by its HOME vendor's id; running those agents on another vendor's harness needs a tier map, or every agent silently collapses onto whatever the session happens to run.
how: A tier is a rough capability/price band, not an equivalence. Entries are a starting point for routing, never a claim that two models behave alike. Availability is NOT recorded here: it is per-account and is checked against the live model list when the map is applied, so a model absent from a plan falls back to the harness default instead of pinning an id that errors.

caveats.small: The small-tier pairing is provisional: the OpenAI side is newer than the Anthropic model it stands in for and may be stronger than the band suggests. Re-check before relying on it for a cost-sensitive route.
